periods.description: 关系网: 好感度: type: number range: [0, 100] check: update when sharing meals, helping, joint hunts; decrease when refusing food or betraying trust 信任度: type: number range: [0, 100] check: update when character confides or entrusts mission; decrease when breaking promises 剧情: 当前卷: type: number range: [1, 12] check: increment when 推进许可 is true AND chapter reaches climax 当前章节: type: string check: update when storyline completes major phase 模式: type: string check: switch between 日常/推进 based on pacing 推进许可: type: boolean check: set true after sufficient buildup; reset after chapter transition 人生菜单: 前菜/汤/鱼/肉/主菜/沙拉/甜点/饮料: type: string check: update when encountering worthy ingredient for that course slot 食材图鉴: 已捕获: type: boolean check: set true when capturing target 已品尝: type: boolean check: set true when eating prepared ingredient 当前委托: 委托名: type: string check: set when accepting IGO request 目标: type: string check: describe objective 完成: type: boolean check: set true when fulfilled
